reviewStandard: Four cleared routes each received exactly one built-in generation call; the two editorially conflicted routes received none. All four originals were preserved and independently inspected at native 1536 by 1024 resolution. Literal body and group counts, U-shaped open-trough geometry, anatomy or material boundaries, prohibited content, outer 32-pixel field, crop bounds, exact hashes, and conservative meaning controlled disposition. Three exact hashes are eligible for separate Control Tower acceptance; the nodular-appearing thyroid output is an immutable non-public quarantine.

routeDecisions.reason: The current article conflates overlapping Mendelian-randomization datasets with independent replication, misattributes LPS production to Gram-positive Lachnospiraceae, uses PDE5 efficacy to overvalidate an upstream microbiome pathway, and substantially overlaps the erectile-dysfunction entity.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Reconcile independent article scope versus an erectile-dysfunction subsection or alias; correct source accounting, bacterial/LPS language, and causal or clinical claims; then re-audit a neutral component-domain representation.

routeDecisions.reviewingAuthority: WikiBiome Control Tower multi-reviewer scientific and editorial audit
routeDecisions.reason: The current article reverses the cited 3-HPAA/GPX4/ferroptosis result and adds an unsupported gut-iron and siderophore propagation inference.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Correct the 3-HPAA result, remove or independently source the siderophore inference, distinguish animal evidence from human translation, and then re-audit neutral component-domain media.

assets.scientificFinding: The gut-kidney axis is a WikiBiome composite without an exact external ontology identity. Human and preclinical CKD evidence supports a research domain involving colon-derived solutes, microbiome and metabolome associations, and renal function, while increased plasma toxin concentration can chiefly reflect reduced clearance rather than increased microbial generation. The plate therefore depicts only separate normal component contexts.
assets.visualReview: Exactly three separated groups and seven primary models are present: one roofless U-ended gastrointestinal trough, four separate generic microbial bodies, and two complete smooth external kidneys.
